causal_sign.long_when: yesterday's imbalance most negative (aggressive selling dominated)
causal_sign.short_when: yesterday's imbalance most positive (aggressive buying dominated)
causal_sign.mechanism_justification: if aggressive flow carried private information it would be priced through within the session, so block-level divergence between flow and price progress identifies price-insensitive demand; once would-be buyers have executed the demand curve shifts left and makers re-widen quotes to rebuild target inventory, mechanically pushing price back toward their entry band
causal_sign.not_claimed: no conditioning on volatility, trend, funding, breadth or any state variable; sign is unconditional and monotonically applied across the whole cross-section

clocks.signal_clock: once per UTC calendar day at the close stamp of the previous day's final 15m bar (D 00:00:00Z)

construction_recipe_steps: build completed-bar table per symbol ascending by close stamp with duplicate rejection
for each UTC date D in [scored_start+1d, scored_end] form the 96-bar block B_i(D) by close stamp range
mark symbol eligible iff len(B_i(D)) == 96; drop ineligible symbols from that day's cross-section
skip the entire rebalance if eligible count < MIN_ELIGIBLE, carrying prior weights unchanged
Q_i = sum(quote_volume); F_i = sum(taker_buy_quote_volume)/Q_i in [0,1]; A_i = 2*F_i - 1 in [-1,1]
cross-sectionally standardise over eligible i with sample stdev ddof=1 giving A_hat_i; if stdev==0 set all A_hat_i=0
raw_i = -A_hat_i
solve lambda >= 0 such that sum(|clip(lambda*raw_i, +/-CAP)|) == 1.0 by deterministic bisection bracket [0,1e6], 200 halvings or residual < 1e-12
emit targets w_i = clip(lambda*raw_i, +/-CAP)
trade to targets at the open of the bar opening at D 00:00:00Z charging baseline costs on traded notional
accrue native funding across settlements between boundaries
force-flat everything at the final scored-window boundary

economic_source.counterparty_primary: small-ticket retail crowd plus the passive depth selling into their euphoria or buying their panic
economic_source.counterparty_secondary: better-capitalised holders receiving inventory down-scale during capitulation
why_they_exist: crypto perps offer the lowest-friction highest-leverage 24/7 access of any asset class
their decision cycle is attention-driven rather than valuation-driven
they systematically transact after the informational content of a move has been realised
someone must take the other end and compensation for doing so at peak participation is the subsequent unwind

pit_inputs.derived_statistic: ticket_size_i(D) = sum_B quote_volume / sum_B count  [USDT per trade]
pit_inputs.reference_distribution: 30 daily ticket_size values over the audited pre-window 2025-07-22T00:00Z..2025-08-21T00:00Z, frozen once at scored window start and never updated during OOS
pit_inputs.pit_safety_argument: every reference element strictly precedes every scored decision; no adaptive threshold, no recursion, no refresh; per-symbol references keep the trigger scale-free across the ~6 orders of magnitude span from PEPE to BNB

causal_sign.direction: fade the crowd's direction on a record-low average-ticket directional day
causal_sign.short_trigger: ticket_size_i(D) < m_i AND r_i(D) > 0 => euphoric small-buyer absorption => expected negative forward return
causal_sign.long_trigger: ticket_size_i(D) < m_i AND r_i(D) < 0 => panic small-holder liquidation => expected positive forward return
causal_sign.non_trigger_case: r_i(D) == 0 is logged only and never triggers
causal_sign.mechanism_justification: composition identifies a population and populations have stable behavioural horizons; retail flows arrive late relative to information and face binding margin and attention constraints, so when their participation reaches an extreme the incremental source of directional pressure is about to be exhausted while longer-horizon holders remain present; correction is therefore directional against the crowd and multi-session
causal_sign.contrast_with_prior_volume_usage: every prior family treated volume as a magnitude which confounds many participants with large participants; composition does not, and that distinction is the hypothesis

clocks.signal_clock: evaluated once per completed 96-bar UTC day block but the DECISION clock is event-driven because most symbol-days produce no position
clocks.entry_fill_clock: OPEN of the 15m bar opening exactly at D 00:00:00Z
clocks.exit_fill_clock: force-close at the fill event seven UTC days later, i.e. open of the bar opening D+7 00:00:00Z
clocks.distinctness: only proposal here whose decision times are data-determined rather than a fixed calendar grid

holding_horizon.justification: hand-off unwinds over multiple sessions and must span the full weekly liquidity cycle including the thin weekend regime, so horizon is market-structure-defined rather than searched
holding_horizon.purge_embargo_consequence: embargo >= 7 days automatically satisfies PLAN 11 purge/embargo >= holding horizon
holding_horizon.re_entry_while_live: forbidden; single-position-per-symbol invariant, no queuing or rolling

construction_recipe_steps: load completed 15m bars for the ten required symbols
freeze per-symbol references REF_i = {ticket_size_i(d) : d in pre-window} (30 values), m_i = min(REF_i); hash-pin REF_i and never touch again
for each UTC date D in the scored window form the 96-bar block B_i(D); require exactly 96 bars else skip the symbol
require sum_B count > 0 and sum_B quote_volume > 0 else skip
compute ts_i = sum_B quote_volume / sum_B count and r_i = ln(close(last bar)/open(first bar))
trigger iff ts_i < m_i; direction SHORT if r_i > 0, LONG if r_i < 0; r_i == 0 logs only
skip the trigger if a position in that symbol is already live; do not queue or roll
size each event at GROSS/n_max notional with GROSS=1.0 and n_max=10 giving constant 0.10 per event
execute entries and exits at the specified event opens charging baseline costs per fill and accruing native funding while held
force-flat any surviving position at the final scored-window boundary

proposals.one_line_essence: Idiosyncratic return dislocation versus a leave-one-out peer composite clears slowly because no index or hedging flow enforces cohort consistency, so hold the residual-inverse factor-neutral book.

economic_source.claim: Slow information diffusion and stale-reference quoting leave name-specific return components unsupported once the common factor is removed.
economic_source.counterparty_primary: slow-attention investors acting on absolute price changes rather than peer-relative value
economic_source.counterparty_secondary: passive limit-order traders quoting off stale recent prints
why_they_exist: monitoring a whole cohort costs more than watching one chart
quoting off the last print is cheaper and operationally simpler than repricing to a peer composite
crypto venues are decentralised and non-consolidated with no ETF creation/redemption mechanism mechanically enforcing cohort consistency
economic_source.honest_prior_note: lowest-prior of the three proposals; at top-ten-by-volume liquidity much exploitable diffusion lag may already be arbitraged away, especially at weekly frequency. Proposed because it is structurally novel, cheap to test, occupies an untouched mechanism class, and falsifies cleanly.
economic_source.distinctness_within_this_set: profit source is relative mispricing versus peer consensus rather than any property of a single name's own path or microstructure

series.description: per-bar log return of each of the ten symbols

series.name: r_minus_i,b
series.description: leave-one-out equal-weight panel composite excluding self

pre_window_coefficients_computed_once_be.beta_hat_i: cov(r_i,b , r_minus_i,b) / var(r_minus_i,b) over the 2880 audited pre-window bar pairs
pre_window_coefficients_computed_once_be.sigma_e_i: stdev(r_i,b - beta_hat_i * r_minus_i,b) over the same pairs

pit_inputs.weekly_features: r_i,w = ln(close(M_w)/close(M_w-1)) using close stamps of the last completed 15m bar before consecutive Monday 00:00:00Z boundaries; leave-one-out composite formed analogously on weekly returns
pit_inputs.pit_safety_argument: every weekly feature is fully determined by bars closing at or before the Monday boundary; coefficients predate the first scored decision by the entire pre-window and are hash-pinned and never refitted; nothing else enters

causal_sign.weight_rule: raw_i = -(e_i,w / sigma_e,i) with e_i,w = r_i,w - beta_hat_i * mean_{j!=i}(r_j,w)
causal_sign.mechanism_justification: with the common factor stripped the residual cannot reflect cohort-wide demand; what remains is name-specific pressure, and at a weekly horizon re-pricing toward peer consistency dominates attention-chasing because there is no mechanical holder of the idiosyncratic leg comparable to an index fund, makers rebuild inventories around peer-relative bands, and residual spikes are disproportionately transient order imbalance
causal_sign.normalisation_rationale: dividing by sigma_e,i puts names on a common footing so the bet is on standardised dislocation rather than raw percentage moves
causal_sign.deliberately_not_claimed: momentum continuation, funding carry, or anything driven by absolute return levels

clocks.signal_clock: Monday 00:00:00Z at the close stamp of the final completed 15m bar preceding the boundary; 52 crossing times in the scored window
clocks.fill_clock: OPEN of the 15m bar whose open timestamp equals the Monday boundary
clocks.clock_reuse_disclosure: weekly Monday clock reuses an existing harness convention purely to reduce implementation risk and is expressly NOT claimed as novelty

holding_horizon.value: one UTC week rebalanced at every Monday boundary
holding_horizon.force_flat_rule: flattened at the final scored-window boundary

construction_recipe_steps: load completed 15m bars for the ten required symbols and build per-bar log returns aligned on close stamps requiring all ten names present per slot for composite formation
using pre-window slots only compute and freeze beta_hat_i and sigma_e,i per symbol; hash-pin them
for each scored week w compute weekly log returns for all ten names across the Monday boundary pair
compute e_i,w = r_i,w - beta_hat_i * mean_{j!=i}(r_j,w)
set raw_i = -e_i,w / sigma_e,i
apply the identical cap-and-normalise routine as M01 solving lambda so sum(|clip(lambda*raw_i, +/-CAP)|) == 1.0 then emit w_i
trade to targets at the open of the bar opening at the Monday boundary charging baseline costs on traded notional
accrue native funding across settlements during the week
repeat weekly and force-flat at the final scored-window boundary
